file.description: One nonempty binary file part. For batch, inspect only the first 4096 bytes: strip an optional leading UTF-8 BOM, require the first non-ASCII-whitespace byte to be {, and reject NUL in that head. Vision requires PNG, JPEG, GIF87a/GIF89a or RIFF/WEBP signatures; this is header sniffing, not full image decoding. Other accepted purposes store opaque nonempty bytes. Full batch-line validation occurs at Batch creation.

expires_after[seconds].description: Integer seconds in 3600..2592000; both expiry fields required together.

input_file_id.description: Gateway file id. Malformed, missing, foreign and hidden ids all produce 404, not input-validation 400.

anyOf.description: At most 16 entries, nonempty keys <=64 UTF-8 bytes, string values <=512 bytes; omg_mode auto|gateway; omg_retries 0|1|2. Map cardinality/key constraints require handler validation, as for System One maps.
